scope.executed: Read published source, images and JSON; verify public byte hashes; recompute ratios and group summaries from reported statistics.

definitions.depth: Colour optical-axis Z in metres, compared in target camera coordinates.
definitions.unconditional_abs_m: All common observed target pixels with measured target Z in [0.3, upper]; projected source Z is unrestricted above zero.
definitions.both_in_window_abs_m: Additionally require projected source Z in target axes in [0.3, upper]; source-camera Z is not range-gated by this test.
definitions.visible_abs_m: Conditional statistic removing target depth-edge dilation, target D2C collision mask, and predicted Z minus measured Z > max(0.05 m, 0.03 * measured Z). This residual-dependent filter is not independently verified visibility.
definitions.overlap: Common observed target pixel, not proof of a corresponding mutually visible surface.
definitions.group_summary: Min, median and max of existing per-pair statistics. Not pooled pixel-level quantiles.
definitions.sign: Positive means projected source is behind the measured target surface.

pair_164_to_179_positive_tail_inference.reason: The negative-residual bound on the raw superset is below the absolute P95 of the both-in-window subset.
pair_164_to_179_positive_tail_inference.interpretation: The heaviest approximately 5% tail is source-behind-target. Consistent with occlusion/correspondence contamination, but pose or depth errors can also yield this sign; causation is not identified.

scale_support.interpretation: Internal train-depth/SfM consistency, not external metric accuracy or trajectory ground truth.
